question: Can high-cost Abaqus 2024 API boundaries be converted into narrow licensed runtime notes while pruning notes that add context without Product benefit?

pruned_after_product_evaluation.reason: Duplicated normal Skill/official guidance and used 6 rather than 4 CAE calls in the 3-attempt automatic/off comparison.
No Product treatment evidence and the assembly-owned normal path was already stated in Skill.
No Product treatment evidence and the assembly-owned normal path was already stated in Skill.

note_policy.physical_non_goals: No note chooses surface side, beam n1 direction, profile dimensions, material region, load magnitude, output acceptance value, or model topology.

ast_routes: localized or English feature-creation failure with one unambiguous Assembly.Surface call
localized TypeError keyword error on Model.BeamSection.orientation or geometricType
invalid FieldOutputRequest variables with one unambiguous call
automatic_routing.boundary: AbaqusException/TypeError routing requires a workspace traceback frame and a single AST-resolved call. Parameter-scoped notes must intersect the explicit failing parameter or call keywords. Generic solver errors and ambiguous frames remain unrouted.

catalog_merge_correction.after: one public-overload card preserving MeshEditPart and MeshPart signatures

product_evidence.headline: Assembly.Set showed strong small-sample long-tail reduction; Assembly.Surface showed mixed positive evidence; setElementType and BeamSection were correct fallbacks without demonstrated call savings; redundant SectionAssignment/BC/load notes were pruned.

interpretation.capability: final13 retains ten new licensed behavior notes over final9, including both SIDE1/SIDE2 Surface containers, BeamSection/orientation separation, B31 output semantics, ODB ownership, and cross-dimensional setElementType dispatch.
limits: The official semantic source is 2026 FD02 while runtime observations are explicitly bounded to licensed Abaqus 2024.
Product treatment batches are small and use one model/gateway; they do not establish a universal success rate.
Automatic notes are reactive and do not prevent proactive probes or source-level repairs before a runtime error.
A verified API note does not replace host verification, physics intent, or convergence control.
